data.body:
fix(outbound-differ): comment dedup fix committed — commit 23705b8f51 on branch audit/c2-leaf-gap-agent.

Root cause (DIG-5287 idempotency stall 27→18→18): _diff_comments in outbound_differ.py had two bugs that caused every local comment to be re-emitted as an 'add' on every reconciler pass:

1. Wrong snapshot key: the function read jira_issue.get('comments', []) but the Jira REST API stores comments at fields['comment']['comments'] (outer key is 'comment', not 'comments'). The fetcher writes the snapshot verbatim from the fields dict, so jira_issue['comment']['comments'] is the correct lookup. Because the key was always wrong, jira_bodies was always empty and all local comments were re-emitted unconditionally.

2. ADF body mismatch: Jira Cloud v3 returns comment bodies as ADF documents (nested dicts). Without adf_to_text() normalisation, the differ compared local plain-text bodies against ADF dicts and they never matched.

Fix: read jira_issue.get('comment', {}).get('comments', []) for the Jira comment list; apply _normalise_comment_body() on both sides (adf_to_text() for ADF documents, str() passthrough otherwise) and strip() whitespace before equality comparison. Body equality after normalisation → skip; otherwise emit 'add'.

Labels (via _diff_labels) already use set-diff and were idempotent; no label fix needed.

Tests: 5 new unit tests in test_outbound_differ_comment_dedup.py — all RED before fix, GREEN after. 21 pre-existing inbound-path baseline failures unchanged.
